name: 10039 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10039 (New York) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10039 (New York) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10039 (New York) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
